definitions.explanation: The money a company spends on advertising, treated as a cost item in accounting and business planning.

examples.japanese: {広告費|こうこくひ}を{削|けず}ることにした。
examples.english: We decided to cut advertising expenses.

examples.japanese: {今期|こんき}は{広告費|こうこくひ}が{売上|うりあげ}の{一割|いちわり}を{占|し}めた。
examples.english: This term, advertising expenses accounted for ten percent of sales.

examples.japanese: テレビからネットへ{広告費|こうこくひ}を{移|うつ}した{結果|けっか}、{若|わか}い{客層|きゃくそう}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: As a result of shifting the ad spend from television to the internet, the customer base grew younger.

notes:
{広告|こうこく} (advertisement) + {費|ひ} (expense). Part of the standard family of business cost words formed with {費|ひ}, alongside {人件費|じんけんひ} and {交通費|こうつうひ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広告費|こうこくひ}を{削減|さくげん}する: to cut advertising expenses
- {広告費|こうこくひ}をかける: to spend money on advertising
- {広告費|こうこくひ}の{予算|よさん}: the advertising budget

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宣伝費|せんでんひ}: publicity expenses — nearly synonymous; covers promotion beyond paid ads
- {販促費|はんそくひ}: sales promotion expenses — campaigns and giveaways rather than media buying
